caption: Indians lost Rs 22,845 crore to cyber fraud in 2024, up 206% in a year. Double your money in 6 months means 300% a year, and nobody real can pay that. If you ever lose money, call 1930 at once.

pages.body: Indians lost that much to cyber fraud in 2024 alone, up 206% in one year. Most of it started with a promise that sounded too good.
pages.heading: Rs 22,845 crore lost.
pages.name: scale
pages.note: Ministry of Home Affairs, Lok Sabha, 2025.

pages.body: Any one of these is enough to walk away.
pages.heading: One is enough.
items: No real investment guarantees high returns. Guaranteed and high means fake.
Real investments wait. Scams rush you.
If your payout needs someone else to join after you, it is a Ponzi scheme.
pages.name: flags123

pages.body: Check the people and the paperwork before the money moves.
pages.heading: Two more warnings.
items: No SEBI or RBI registration, no company address, only a Telegram group.
Real investments pay from profits, not from your friends joining.
pages.name: flags45

pages.body: Double your money in 6 months sounds exciting. Annualised, that is 300% a year. A fixed deposit pays about 6.5%. Ask where the other 294% comes from.
pages.heading: Do the doubling maths.
pages.name: returntest

pages.body: Do these before any money moves. If it fails one check, do not invest.
pages.heading: Three quick checks.

items: Never invest from a cold call
inner.title: The 2-minute check
